goal: Add speech-to-text dictation to task entry.
outcome: In the existing task editor, users can dictate into the editable task title, review and edit the transcript, and save only with the existing Save action. Request microphone and speech-recognition permissions as needed. Use on-device recognition; report unavailable recognition or denied permission with a clear recovery path. Do not parse dates, reminders, priorities, multiple tasks, call an AI service, or save an unconfirmed transcript in this slice.

requirements.statement: Voice dictation only populates the task title; structured speech parsing is separate future work.
All task data remains local. Recognition must request on-device mode and must not fall back to a server.
Android and iOS request the required microphone and speech-recognition permissions. Denial or unavailable on-device recognition leaves the task editable and unsaved.
